author: reek
body: n1 and n2 pin the operand save: an operation name is a bare name in the source and a call in the machine, so the left operand of `get-a + get-b` has to survive the branch that fetches the right. Answering 40 there is both operands reading the second call's result. Clause order is varied because it must not matter.

author: reek
body: n3 and n4 pin the handler save: a handle saves the handler it displaces, and doing that on the stack moves SP out from under every spill slot in the body. The multiplier makes the two operations tell each other apart, and the two handles in sequence are what makes one overwrite the other.
